purpose: Visual exploration only; not implemented app screens
sharedPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished, high-fidelity actual mobile game SCREEN mockup for PROMPT WARS, a competitive creative-writing battle game. This is a visual redesign study, not a new card game.
Design direction: the tactile, bold, art-led collectible presentation of Marvel Snap, translated into ORIGINAL Prompt Wars identity. Use coherent beveled near-black collectible cards, confident condensed italic uppercase display headings, extremely readable regular sans-serif body text, sharp restrained chamfered corners, generous negative space, crisp thin brushed-gold edges, violet crystal accents and cyan/ember move accents. Cinematic illustrated fighter art, matte obsidian interface, rich violet lighting restrained to the hero region. No Marvel characters or logos. NO tiny cramped UI, casino UI, random currency, energy or invented deck mechanics. Minimal particles, clean production-quality mobile UI.
Canvas: one edge-to-edge front-on phone SCREEN, portrait approximately 9:19.5 ratio, 1170x2532 if possible. No physical phone hardware, no outer presentation board, no annotations or callouts. Native top status bar reading 9:41, adequate top/bottom safe areas. Clear legible exact UI text. Layout based on a 390pt wide phone with 20pt horizontal margins, body 15-16pt, target minimum48pt controls. Text must not overlap ornament.
Shared identity: sample fighter MIRA, the same pale adult female mystic with charcoal hood and violet robe from reference, glowing golden glyph ring circling her hands. Preserve face, costume and magical ring. Card frame derives from supplied Astral Codex asset: obsidian, thin gold metal, violet crystal corner accents and a small quill/book crest, pared down enough for a modern game. Keep character face/hands visible. Do not add character rarity or purchasable stat upgrades.
Colors: background #0B0B13, panel #171721, main text #FAF7FF, secondary #BBB7CE, lavender #C4AFFE with dark ink text, gold #D5AD63, cyan #55CFE4, ember #ED886A. Gold denotes ornament, violet denotes brand/action. Primary filled buttons have DARK lettering on lavender, never low contrast.
Navigation on root Arena screen: five positions, Arena, Battles, raised CENTER Battle, Rankings, Profile. All have labeled crisp line icons, central Battle is a purple faceted circular button with crossed-quill mark, all targets at least48pt. Secondary Shop and active battle workspace have labeled back/exit and appropriate footer, not another tab destination.

SCREEN 1: ARENA / HOME.
Reference image1 is the actual current fighter art to reuse; reference image2 is the actual current frame material and ornament to integrate. Create the new interface around them.
From top to bottom:
- Small native status bar.
- Compact masthead PROMPT WARS at left; at right a subtle credit diamond and "150" then small MIRA portrait.
- Heading "ENTER THE ARENA" with small supporting line "Your words. Your fighter."
- Main hero: single large upright collectible fighter card, approximately 290pt wide and355pt high, centered in a faint violet spotlight on obsidian. Art occupies most of card, MIRA name in a dark inset titleplate, underneath "Mystic". Her head and glyph-ring hands clearly readable, no cropping of identity. Decorative corner pieces concise not gigantic.
- Directly attached to card bottom a clean four-column stat tray with full readable labels, each value 5: "Strength", "Stamina", "Agility", "Focus". No other fighter stats.
- Two restrained secondary actions in a row below card: "Customize" and "Cosmetics".
- One compact actionable horizontal strip: "2 rounds need you" with a right arrow and supporting label "Open Battles". No timer or daily challenge.
- Clear small centered line "Theme revealed after matching." immediately above nav.
- Bottom persistent five-position nav: Arena selected, Battles with badge2, prominent raised CENTER Battle, Rankings, Profile. The central label is "Battle"; no duplicate giant battle button elsewhere.
Keep everything visible with balanced generous spacing and safe area. This should feel like a beautiful real collectible game home, not a dashboard of rounded widgets. Large art and confident branding, readable understated utility chrome.

SCREEN 2: ACTIVE BATTLE WORKSPACE, pre-submission, keyboard closed.
Reference image1 is the already-designed Arena screen: match its card materials, typography hierarchy and violet/gold palette, but use much less ornament so reading and writing are comfortable. Reference image2 is original opponent ROOK, a hooded amber-lit trickster; use it only for the opponent thumbnail. Same exact MIRA face and hood as image1.
Top to bottom:
- Native status bar 9:41.
- Labeled upper-left back control "Return to Arena"; upper-right discreet "..." overflow. No full bottom tab bar in battle.
- Heading "ROUND 1 OF 3", small label "Ranked · First to 2 wins".
- Compact horizontal duel banner: on left small simplified collectible MIRA portrait with "MIRA" and "100 / 100 HP" with violet HP strip; on right ROOK amber portrait with "ROOK" and "100 / 100 HP". Center "VS" and a small "0 — 0" round-win score. Both fighters same visual weight. Entire duel header compact, no giant hero cards.
- A small atmospheric illustrated theme plaque, generous readable text "THE LAST LIBRARY". Small caption "Theme" above, then "Protect the final book as the city falls."
- Small exact deadline "Submit by 15 Sep, 22:00" with clock icon.
- Subheading "Choose your move", then three equal-width restrained chamfered move controls: lightning icon "Attack" selected with ember outline/check; shield icon "Defense" cyan; skull icon "Finisher" violet. NO costs, energy, cooldown or card-deck mechanics.
- Clear main writing area, largest functional region. Header "Your prompt", at right "Ideas" secondary action. Textarea on solid matte #171721 panel, thin quiet border, 16pt equivalent readable sentence case regular sans text:
"I weave a shield of living words around the last book. Every falling brick becomes a letter, rebuilding the library while a storm of ink drives my rival back."
Show visible caret at end and generous blank writing space under text. No imagery behind text.
- Below editor "Draft saved on this device" with small checkmark.
- Bottom safe-area action footer always visible: prominent full-width lavender primary control with DARK INK TEXT "Hold to lock in" plus restrained quill icon and slim hold-progress edge. Secondary line "Your prompt stays editable until you submit." A small visible link "Use confirmation instead" for accessibility alternative.
Much more restrained than Arena. Strongest visual focus is writing area and single submission action. Confident mobile-game shell around a comfortable real text editor. Every specified essential label legible, all fits without crowding.

SCREEN 3: COSMETIC SHOP / FRAME COLLECTION.
Reference image1 is the already-designed Arena screen: maintain its exact MIRA fighter identity, gold typography, obsidian card materials and violet accents. Reference image2 Emberforge, image3 Neon Circuit, image4 Laureate are the existing frame artwork to reuse for their corresponding items. Astral Codex appearance comes from image1.
The same fighter MIRA appears in ALL frame previews so changes are visibly cosmetic, not new characters. Keep her hands/glyphs and face visible inside frame.
Top to bottom:
- Native status bar 9:41.
- Labeled back arrow "Arena" at left, small purple credit diamond and "150" at right.
- Strong bold display heading "COSMETIC SHOP", sentence-case quiet subtitle "Make your fighter unmistakable."
- Compact equipped strip: little MIRA avatar wearing Astral frame and clear text "Wearing Astral Codex" with smaller "Frame · Equipped". Thin divider, NOT oversized text panel.
- Categories as a compact horizontally arranged text navigation: "Frames" selected, "Titles", "Auras", "Badges", "Colours"; understated violet selected indicator, normal readable text, no giant pills.
- Filter "All" selected and "Owned" understated alternative.
- Art-first TWO-COLUMN gallery with two rows, four distinct beautiful collectibles. Each tile clean matte background, large frame preview with MIRA inside, frame occupies 70% of tile; name and state/price BELOW image in a flat dark plaque, never over ornate border. All prices fully readable.
  top-left: "Astral Codex", rarity "Epic", state "Equipped" with green check, secondary "Preview" button. Violet crystals/gold quill frame.
  top-right: "Emberforge", rarity "Epic", "25 credits", separate outlined "Preview" button. Ember orange scorched-metal frame.
  bottom-left: "Neon Circuit", rarity "Epic", "25 credits", separate outlined "Preview" button. Graphite cyan/magenta frame.
  bottom-right: "Laureate", rarity "Legendary", "40 credits", second small line "or earn with 50 wins", separate outlined "Preview" button. Emerald gold laurel/crossed-quill frame.
- A small calm note at bottom "Cosmetics never affect battle stats." with shield-check icon. No fake limited-time offer, loot-box, random pack, countdown or BUY ALL.
No root nav on this secondary screen. This is a collection gallery; detailed preview opens purchase/equip actions later. Airy hierarchy, approximately 350pt useful width, real touch targets. Understated UI ornament lets four asset materials sing. Entire four-card collection visibly fits.
